payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, specifically through a multimodal approach.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by utilizing a hybrid LSTM-CNN architecture that processes both modalities for named entity recognition.
The proposed multimodal NER (MNER) system significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts alongside textual information.
The model includes a modality attention module that enhances the integration of visual and textual data, allowing for improved recognition of named entities.
